events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worktree state and probe summary
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-t299 && git log --oneline -3 && git status --short | head -20 && echo --- && cat /tmp/t299/probes-summary.txt | tail -40; ls /tmp/t299/

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe run scripts and process state
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t299 && cat run-probes.sh; echo ---; cat start.sh; echo ---; for f in *.pid; do p=$(cat $f); echo "$f $p $(ps -p $p -o command= 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-80)"; done; ls -la --time-style=+%H:%M p-*.log r-*.log probes-summary.txt 2>/dev/null || ls -lT p-*.log r-*.log probes-summary.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read failing probe logs
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t299 && tail -8 p-probe-domain-chain.log; echo ---; cat p-probe-day1.log; echo ---; grep -E 'FAIL|not ok|Error' p-probe-stack.log | head; echo; cat sim-reset.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check main drift and run-chain contents
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-t299 && git fetch -q . main:refs/remotes/local/main 2>/dev/null; git rev-list --count HEAD..main; git log --oneline HEAD..main -- app/scripts/probe-day1.mjs app/scripts/probe-day2.mjs app/scripts/probe-domain-chain.mjs app/scripts/probe-stack.mjs app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head; echo ---; grep -n 'probe-\|FUNNEL\|stack' app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect dirty file in worktree
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-t299 && git diff --stat cloud/.export-centre.sh; git log --oneline -1 -- cloud/.export-centre.sh; git diff cloud/.export-centre.sh | head -20
